sequences.name: Seer
abilities: Enhanced Memory: Continuously improving memory, helps in learning Ritualistic Magic and Divination Arts.
Spirituality: Enhanced spirituality upon drinking the potion.
Spirit Vision: Can see non-physical things like ghosts and specters, deduce health and emotions, and detect magical auras.
Divination Arts & Ritualistic Magic: Mastery of divination methods including astrology, spiritual numbers, and scrying.
Danger Intuition: Can intuitively detect danger using spirituality.

sequences.name: Clown
abilities: Physical Enhancement: Strong control over body, master acrobat, complete control over bodily functions and facial expressions.
Enhanced Spirituality: Marginally enhanced spirituality.
Enhanced Danger Intuition: Greatly enhanced, can sometimes predict the next action of others.
Paper Daggers: Can temporarily turn sheets of paper as hard and sharp as steel.

sequences.name: Magician
abilities: Physical Enhancement: More agile and nimble hands.
Spirit Vision: Slightly enhanced ability to see spiritual things.
Damage Transfer: Can transfer wounds to different areas, turning fatal wounds into minor injuries.
Flaming Jump: Can phase through fire sparks and flames within 30 meters.
Air Bullet: Can produce air projectiles comparable to bullets.
Paper Figurine Substitute: Can transform a paper figurine into themselves to block fatal blows.
Flame Controlling: Can freely manipulate flames within 30 meters.
Underwater Breathing: Can create an invisible air pipe to breathe underwater.
Bone Softening: Can soften bones to escape restraints.
Drawing Paper As Weapons: Can turn paper into various weapons.
Illusion Creation: Can create illusions with colors, sounds, and smells.

sequences.name: Faceless
abilities: Shapeshifting: Can freely mold body and flesh to mimic others perfectly.
Enhanced Previous Abilities: Flame Controlling, Flaming Jump, and other powers become stronger.
Combat, Tracking, and Anti-Tracking: Improved due to shapeshifting and bodily control.

sequences.name: Marionettist
abilities: Spirit Body Threads Manipulation: Can perceive and manipulate Spirit Body Threads from up to 100 meters away.
Marionette: Can turn targets into marionettes under full control.
Enhanced Abilities: Air Bullet strength comparable to a steam rifle.

sequences.name: Bizarro Sorcerer
abilities: Enhanced Spirituality and Divination.
Bestowal: Can gift Worms of Spirit to marionettes.
Concealment: Can hide their sequence level.
Enhanced Abilities: Damage Transfer, Air Cannon, Flaming Jump, Illusion Creation, Shapeshifting, Spirit Body Threads Manipulation.
Mythical Creature Form: Can split Worms of Spirit.

sequences.name: Scholar of Yore
abilities: History: Can borrow strength from the past, summon historical projections, and hide in the historical void.
Enhanced Abilities: Paper Figurine Substitutes, Damage Transfer, Flaming Jump, Air Cannon, Shapeshifting, Spirit Body Threads Manipulation.
Mythical Creature Form: Can split more Worms of Spirit.

sequences.name: Miracle Invoker
abilities: Enhanced Spirituality and Soul aspects.
Authorities: Miracles (can grant wishes), Jamming in Fate, Historical Void Summoning.
Resurrection: Can resurrect up to 4 times.
Enhanced Spirit Body Threads Manipulation.
Mythical Creature Form: Complete Mythical Creature form.

sequences.name: Attendant of Mysteries
abilities: Regenerate: Can regenerate past Spirit Body Threads of items.
Authorities: Reassembly (can graft physical objects and abstract concepts), Realm of Mysteries (concealment), Miracles.
Enhanced Spirit Body Threads Manipulation and Resurrection.
Mythical Creature Form: Evolved Worms of Spirit.

sequences.name: Fool
abilities: Authorities: Fooling (turns falsehood into reality), Reassembly (grafting), Controller of the Spirit World, Puppetry, History, Miracles, Realm of Mysteries (Concealment), Anchor of Destiny, Shapeshifting.
Symbolism: Blind Stupidity (lowers IQ of targets).
General Traits: Extreme deity with ability to destroy a star but weak defense.
